title: 31-row cost-16 parent: sextet-era census closing the quint-order I-E truncation at k = 26, 27, 28

rank28_preread.note: the parallel lane's rank-28 preread (census values identical to this lane's independent derivation) does not cover the size >= 6 censuses; this script adds and closes them

scope.classifier: zero if a row occurs at least 3 times or at least two rows occur twice; b_only if exactly one row occurs twice; disjoint if no row is repeated.  A-type covers (15 disjoint pairs + 1 disjoint singleton) touch every row exactly once; B-type covers (16 pairs) touch exactly one row twice.  A zero subset therefore fits no cover and its joint is exactly 0.
scope.hereditary_lemma: zero is superset-closed; all-zero C(n,6) therefore closes every size >= 6 for the top-n.
scope.warning: Membership and joint counts are cover-plan counts, not search costs, verdicts, or game outcomes.

retroactive_and_prospective_closure.kill_26: C(26,6) all zero closes the published kill(26) quint-order truncation retroactively
retroactive_and_prospective_closure.kill_27: C(27,6) all zero closes the published kill(27) quint-order truncation retroactively
retroactive_and_prospective_closure.kill_28: C(28,6) all zero pre-approves the k=28 layer: the k=28 I-E may keep the k=27 quint mechanism and needs no sixth-order term
retroactive_and_prospective_closure.note: the C(28,7)/C(28,8) censuses are empirical anchors one order beyond the lemma

detail.ie_mechanism_of_k26: kill(k) = sum m - sum j2 + sum j3 - sum j4 + sum j5 for k <= 26; kill_A(k) = sum a - sum j2_A + sum j3_A - sum j4_A (j5_A == 0); kill_B(k) = sum b - sum j2_B + sum j3_B - sum j4_B + sum j5_B; j4_A comes from the 233 disjoint quads (first appearance), j5_B from the 1,872 b_only quints

detail.ie_mechanism_of_k27: kill(k) = sum m - sum j2 + sum j3 - sum j4 + sum j5 for k <= 27; kill_A(k) = sum a - sum j2_A + sum j3_A - sum j4_A (j5_A == 0); kill_B(k) = sum b - sum j2_B + sum j3_B - sum j4_B + sum j5_B; j4_A comes from the 255 disjoint quads (233 published at k=26, 22 new at k=27), j5_B from the 2,181 b_only quints (1,872 prev, 309 new)

detail.lemma: zero is superset-closed: if subset S has a row hit >= 3 times, or two rows hit twice, every superset of S does too; and every subset of size >= 6 of the top-26/27/28 contains a 6-subset, which the census shows is zero.
detail.consequence: no subset of size >= 6 of the top-26/27/28 admits any A-type or B-type minimum cover, so every joint j(S) with |S| >= 6 is exactly 0 and the quint-order truncation of kill(k) for k = 26, 27, 28 is complete

interpretation_guard: Structural census of minimum-cover ban combinations only. No Pm joint value was computed here for size >= 6 subsets (they are all structurally zero); no game position was classified; no engine search was started.
